text:
sam: Quick question from today's all-hands 
Can we get clearer windows for: 1) API streaming (low-latency canary + GA), 2) Console: Optimize recommendations beta, 3) public quantization+packing guidance? My team needs dates for sprint planning.

olivia (CEO): Brief: streaming canary ~6w, GA depends on canary stability (~+3-4w if all good). Console Optimize beta ~10w with staged rollout. Quantization guidance/beta late-quarter. We'll publish a timeline doc with owners by EOW.

nina (Product): Clarify: the Console beta is invite-only at first (customers + internal). We want feedback cycles before opening more broadly.

tariq (Eng): Streaming runtime status: one regression in attention kernel; we think it's fixed but running extra perf runs. Our target is p50 token latency <120ms at baseline load. If that holds, canary proceeds.

priya (Optimize Eng): Backend for suggestions is done. UI work is the long pole. We want a toggle in Console and telemetry opt-in. Suggestion: make beta free and non-billable so customers can try without friction.

maria (PM): Action: I'll collate exact dates and feature flags in a single sheet and tag owners. Expect an initial draft today. @tariq @priya please add gating metrics.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment planned: streaming-runtime-canary -> 2027-08-12T09:00Z

sam: Two quick follow-ups: will rollouts include auto-fallback to quantized variants if latency spikes? and will Optimize suggestions be opt-in by default?

nina (Product): Yes on fallback policy 
Policy: if p95 latency > SLO for 3 mins, route affected traffic to compatible quantized or non-streaming endpoints.

priya (Optimize Eng): Recommend opt-in default for telemetry, with an explicit Console checkbox and clear retention policy. Beta suggestions not billed.

lee (Security): We require telemetry to be hashed/aggregated, no raw prompts off by default. If product docs retention & ACLs, security can greenlight.

kia-marketing: Will prepare a short customer note for the beta invite list once dates firm up. Need copy + brief FAQ.

olivia (CEO): Thanks. Next steps: maria to publish timeline doc + owners; engineering to confirm gating numbers; security to confirm telemetry controls. We'll announce in next product update. :sparkles:
